hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/harness/hooks/hook.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; t=; command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1 && t="timeout 3"; p=; for c in python python3 py; do a=; [ "$c" = py ] && a=-3; $t "$c" $a -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { p=$c; break; }; done; [ -n "$p" ] || exit 0; "$p" $a "$f" pre-edit; rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] && exit 2; exit 0
